blocks.h2: Sump Pump Questions From Mokena Homeowners

items.q: How long do sump pumps last?
items.answer: Most pumps last about 7 to 10 years, less if they run a lot. If yours is older, replacing it before it fails is cheaper than a flooded basement.

items.q: Do I need a battery backup sump pump?
items.preview: If your basement is finished, yes.
items.answer: If your basement is finished or you store anything down there, yes. Heavy storms and power outages often come together.

items.q: Why does my sump pump run when it hasn't rained?
items.preview: High groundwater, a stuck float or a bad check valve.
items.answer: It can be high groundwater, a float that's stuck on or a check valve that lets water fall back into the pit. We'll find out which.

items.q: Where should the sump pump discharge?
items.preview: Away from the house, not into the sewer.
items.answer: Away from the foundation and onto the yard or into a storm drain, never into the sanitary sewer. We'll route it so it drains and doesn't freeze.

items.q: Can you add a second sump pump?
items.preview: Yes, in the same pit or a new one.
items.answer: Yes. A second pump, either a backup in the same pit or a pump in a second pit, gives you protection if the first one fails.

items.q: Why does my sump pump discharge freeze?
items.answer: Water left in the outside line freezes. A freeze guard fitting or a better slope helps.

items.q: How much does sump pump replacement cost in Mokena?
items.preview: It depends on the pump and backup. You'll approve a flat price first.
items.answer: It depends on the pump, whether you add a backup and the condition of the pit and discharge. You'll approve a flat-rate price before we start.
